title: San Franchella returns: Goldenvoice unveils lineup of Coachella acts set to perform in the Bay Area - NewsBreak
text:
By Zara Irshad ,
3 hours ago David Byrne is among the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival performers set to also play in the Bay Area this spring. (Scott Dudelson/Getty Images) Bay Area residents don‚Äôt need to trek down to Southern California to enjoy the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival this spring.
Goldenvoice, the promoter responsible for the annual two-weekend event as well as San Francisco‚Äôs Portola Music Festival , is bringing a curated lineup of Coachella performers to the region for a slate of intimate performances.
The annual April programming, affectionately referred to by many as San Franchella or Fauxchella, offers local music lovers the opportunity to experience a slice of the festival without the desert heat and busy crowds that come with it. It usually takes place around the festival‚Äôs consecutive weekends of performances in April.
While this year‚Äôs festival is set to take place April 10-12 and 17-19 in Indio, the local shows will kick off March 6 with a performance by electronic dance music artist AYYBO at the Midway. The series features more than 15 concerts across the Bay Area through May, including performances by Talking Heads frontman David Byrne at Stanford‚Äôs Frost Amphitheater on April 16; house artist Max Styler at the Regency Ballroom in San Francisco on April 24-25 and singer-songwriter Alex G at San Jose Civic Center on May 8.
San Francisco‚Äôs Midway, Great American Music Hall and Pier 48 are among the other participating venues.
In addition to the Bay Area shows, Goldenvoice is also hosting a slate of Coachella performers at venues across Southern California in April. The promoter is giving away a pair of tickets to each show across the state, as well as a pair of Coachella Weekend 2 passes. Fans can enter online with their email address and phone number.
This year‚Äôs Coachella headliners include Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber and Karol G.
Following Coachella, Goldenvoice is set to stage the annual Stagecoach Music Festival , which is more country-focused. This year‚Äôs lineup ‚Äì¬†running April 24-26 ‚Äî¬†includes Bay Area bands Journey , Counting Crows and Third Eye Blind in addition to headliners Cody Johnson, Lainey Wilson and Post Malone .
Santa Rosa resident and celebrity chef Guy Fieri is also expected to offer cooking demonstrations at the festival.
Meanwhile, Goldenvoice is planning to expand its reach in the Bay Area with a new electronic music event at Pier 48‚Äôs Shed A called Club Dark .
Set to run on select weekends from late February through mid-May, the series will feature a rotating cast of local and international talent, from Peggy Gou and Mau P to DJ Tennis and DJ Seinfeld.
